plans.summary: Investigate gateway checkout latency observations by inspecting gateway metrics, logs, traces, and topology to identify the source of elevated durations.

candidates.statement: The order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, causing the gateway's checkout calls to fail with 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside the order service (code, dependency, or data) is not established; only the failing hop is identified.

report.explanation: Gateway logs and traces consistently show checkout 502s caused by upstream order service 500 responses on POST /v1/orders; the failing hop is the order service, but its internal fault is not yet observed.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders showing the internal error or exception
Order service dependency health (database, downstream services) at incident time

candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its outbound POST to order (/v1/orders) fails with transport errors after ~2s, indicating the order service is unreachable or timing out.
candidates.uncertainty: Cause of the order-side transport failure (crash, network, saturation) is not established; no order-service logs or metrics are present.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502s on /v1/checkout paired with transport errors calling order /v1/orders at ~2s, while /readyz stays 200. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Root cause is bounded to the gateway-to-order call path; the underlying order-side fault requires further evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/metrics for /v1/orders around the incident window
Order service pod/container status and restart counts
Network/DNS reachability between gateway and order
Order downstream dependency (inventory/payment/postgresql) health

candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its outbound POST to order (/v1/orders) fails with transport errors after ~2s, indicating order is unreachable or timing out.
candidates.uncertainty: Cause within order (down, overloaded, or downstream dependency) is not established; no order-side logs or metrics available.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502 on /v1/checkout paired with transport errors calling order, while /readyz stays 200 and checkout p95 is ~2.4s. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Root cause is bounded to the gateway-to-order call path; the specific failing component within order is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/metrics for /v1/orders during the incident window
Order dependency health (inventory, payment, postgresql) to localize the transport failure
Network/DNS or connection error detail (timeout vs refused) from gateway client errors

candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its outbound POST to the order service fails at the transport layer (~2s timeouts), so checkout cannot complete.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order service (or its downstreams) is not established; only the gateway-side transport failure is observed.

report.explanation: All checkout requests return 502 with ~2s latency, and paired client requests to order fail with transport errors while /readyz stays 200. This localizes the fault to the gateway-to-order call, but the underlying cause inside order is unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/metrics for /v1/orders to determine why the connection fails or times out
Order service pod/instance health and readiness status
Network/DNS resolution and connection error details for server_address 'order'

candidates.statement: Checkout latency (p95 ~875ms, max ~968ms) is dominated by gateway's downstream POST /v1/orders call to the order service, which shows matching ~942ms client durations; all responses are 200 with no errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side spans/metrics absent; cannot confirm whether slowness originates in order, inventory, payment, or postgresql.

report.explanation: Gateway observations show elevated but successful checkout latency tracking the order dependency call; no errors or 502s. Root cause is downstream of gateway but not yet localized.

candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream POST to order (/v1/orders) fails with 502; the order service is the failing dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; root cause within order (payment, inventory, postgres) not established.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show every /v1/checkout 502 paired with a client POST to order returning 502, while /readyz stays 200; metrics show checkout 502s and elevated p95. Topology confirms gateway->order. Order-side evidence is needed to localize the root cause.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for /v1/orders to confirm its own failure mode
Order dependency (payment/inventory/postgresql) health to localize root cause

candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its outbound POST to order (/v1/orders) fails with transport errors after ~2s, indicating the order service is unreachable or timing out.
candidates.uncertainty: Cause of the order-side transport failure (crash, network, saturation) is not established; no order-service logs or metrics are present.

output.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502s on /v1/checkout paired with transport errors calling order /v1/orders at ~2s, while /readyz stays 200. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Root cause is bounded to the gateway-to-order call path; the underlying order-side fault requires further evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/metrics for /v1/orders around the incident window
Order service pod/container status and restart counts
Network/DNS reachability between gateway and order
Order downstream dependency (inventory/payment/postgresql) health

candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream POST to order (/v1/orders) fails with 502; the order service is the failing dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; root cause within order (payment, inventory, postgres) not established.

output.explanation: Gateway logs show every /v1/checkout 502 paired with a client POST to order returning 502, while /readyz stays 200; metrics show checkout 502s and elevated p95. Topology confirms gateway->order. Order-side evidence is needed to localize the root cause.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for /v1/orders to confirm its own failure mode
Order dependency (payment/inventory/postgresql) health to localize root cause

Empty counter_evidence_ids requires NOT_APPLICABLE and null explanation. Present counter evidence requires RESOLVED/UNRESOLVED and an explanation. Never use the same ID as support and counter. Scope each candidate to what current observations establish. missing_evidence lists observations still REQUIRED to substantiate that bounded candidate or rule out material alternatives. Optional implementation details or follow-up useful only for a different repair belong in uncertainty. Never omit a real requirement to pass Gate. If current facts are insufficient, declare the missing requirements or hand off. Confidence does not grant authority. Use short text below all schema length limits.
